name: desire for sex
quote: I'm not talking about just ordinary temptation, people.

variations.name: biological sex
variations.description: The purely biological desire for sexual contact is a small part of the story for most of us.

variations.name: validation sex
variations.description: Being attractive enough to find a partner can fulfill a desire for social validation.

variations.name: peer pressure sex
variations.description: Some may feel the need to be sexually active to stay in the graces of a social group.

variations.name: escape sex
variations.description: The act may fill a need for stimulation or a desire to escape from a mundane reality.

commentaries.quote: Conflicting social norms can make any kind of sex complicated. It may help to understand where your own desire is coming from: social pressures, habits, escape, or biology.
